plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs to zero.
Exit all 2x AI/Software and Semiconductor ETFs.
Reduce the Income ETF (QQQI) to 20% to lower concentration.
Hold broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) and remaining quality names.
Maintain a significant cash buffer for capital preservation.
Focus on low drawdown and steady, conservative growth.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly growth. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, aiming for low drawdowns. Expect slower growth compared to other modes.

plan: Reduce exposure to leveraged AI/Software and Semiconductor ETFs.
Trim leveraged Space ETF (SPAL) to 1%.
Buy the inverse Semiconductor ETF (SOXS) for potential downside protection.
Maintain a moderate cash buffer of around 10%.
Blend broad index exposure with quality tech and some inverse ETFs.
Aim for risk-first growth with a target of ~2.5% monthly.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets ~2.5% monthly growth by reducing leverage and concentration. It blends broad market exposure with defensive plays like SOXS. Risk is managed by trimming weaker leveraged positions and maintaining a cash buffer.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged AI/Software and Semiconductor ETFs.
Add leveraged Space ETF (SPAL) to 6%.
Buy inverse Semiconductor ETF (SOXS) for potential downside hedging.
Maintain a smaller cash buffer of around 5%.
Concentrate in high-conviction leveraged plays and inverse ETFs.
Target aggressive growth of ~4% monthly, accepting higher potential drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for ~4% monthly growth by increasing leverage and concentration in high-beta and leveraged ETFs. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risks of leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged and high-beta single names and ETFs.
Increase allocation to the Income ETF (QQQI) to 30%.
Focus on broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) for stability.
Prioritize reliable monthly distributions over aggressive growth.
Maintain a cash buffer for stability and potential reinvestment.
Target ~1% monthly income, accepting NAV fluctuations.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly distributions by shifting to income-generating ETFs like QQQI. It minimizes volatility and risk by exiting all leveraged and speculative positions. NAV can still decline in market downturns.
